lines: Choose a safer supply route or a riskier combat route to prove the atlas can guide real decisions.

messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: That was the patrol. Keep one of their crossbows and the risky route has its proof.
The risky road has answered already. A pillager patrol is moving on this map table.
quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: The atlas has pages, markers, and memory. Now it needs judgment.
Choose the permanent test route: safe asks for four lanterns and eight bread; risky begins a three-pillager ambush and guarantees a crossbow proof item with the larger combat bonus.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: You chose the risky atlas test. Defeat the patrol and carry back a crossbow.
Risky road it is. Come back with proof the danger was real, not just imagined from a warm room.
You chose the safer atlas test. Bring the lanterns and bread for the road kit.
Good. A safer road is not a weaker test; it just asks whether the atlas can keep people fed and lit.
quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: This test choice is permanent. Safe is a supply hand-in; risky is an immediate three-pillager ambush with a guaranteed crossbow and larger bonus.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Choose the atlas test route with the cartographer.
quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Then the atlas keeps studying instead of deciding.
A test is only useful if you choose it honestly.
This choice is permanent: safe needs four lanterns and eight bread; risky launches three pillagers, guarantees the proof crossbow, and pays the larger bonus.
We are not carrying that test right now.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Choose the safer or riskier atlas test route.
quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: The riskier road needs proof that danger was not just guessed at from a safe table.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Carry 1 crossbow as proof of the risky patrol.
The risky road has been defended.
Defeat 3 pillagers to prove the riskier road can be defended.
quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Risk is not courage until someone returns with the account.
Defeat 3 pillagers and carry a crossbow as proof of the riskier route test.
We are not carrying that test right now.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Defeat 3 pillagers and carry a crossbow for the riskier route test.
quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: You chose the riskier road and came back with proof. That is the part an atlas cannot fake.
The riskier test is passed. The atlas now knows that danger can be measured without being worshiped.
The risky patrol still needs proof.
I still need the patrol proof before we call this passed.
Bring the proof when the road is ready.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Return to the cartographer after the risky patrol.
quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: A safe road with light and food. That is not glamorous, which is why it is useful.
The safer test is passed. The atlas now knows that mercy is also a route.
The safe road kit is still missing pieces.
I still need the safer road kit before we call this passed.
Bring the kit when the road is ready.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Return to the cartographer with the safer road kit.
quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: A safe road still needs proof. Bring lanterns and bread, the things a traveler notices only when they are missing.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Bring 8 bread for the safer road kit.
Bring 4 lanterns to light a repeatable road.
quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: The safer road still deserves respect.
Bring 4 lanterns and 8 bread for the safer route test.
We are not carrying that test right now.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.the_atlas_test: Bring 4 lanterns and 8 bread for the safer route test.
